S1129v.or: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beátus Andréas Apóstolus, cujus prævenímus festivitátem, tuum pro nobis implóret auxílium; ut a nostris reátibus absolúti, a cunctis étiam perículis eruámur: Per Dóminum.
S1129v.se: Sacrándum tibi, Dómine, munus offérimus, quo beáti Andréæ Apóstoli tui solémnia recoléntes, purificatiónem quoque nostris méntibus implorámus. Per Dóminum.
S1129v.pc: Percéptis, Dómine, sacraméntis, supplíciter exorámus: ut intercedénte beáto Andréa Apóstolo tuo; quæ pro illíus veneránda gérimus passióne, nobis profíciant ad medélam: Per Dóminum.

en.or: We beseech You, almighty God, that blessed Andrew Your Apostle, whose feast we anticipate, may implore Your help for us; that, absolved from our sins, we may also be delivered from all dangers
en.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gift to be hallowed, by which, keeping the solemnity of blessed Andrew Your Apostle, we implore also the cleansing of our minds
en.pc: Having received Your sacraments, O Lord, we humbly entreat You that, by the intercession of blessed Andrew Your Apostle, what we do in honour of his venerable passion may profit us unto healing

S1207v.or: Deus, qui Unigéniti tui Matrem ab origináli culpa in sua Conceptióne mirabíliter præservásti: da quǽsumus, ut sua nos intercessióne munítos; corde mundos fácias suæ interésse festivitáti: Per eúmdem.
S1207v.se: Múnera nostra, Dómine, apud tuam cleméntiam, immaculátæ Dei Genitrícis comméndet oratio: quam ab omni origináli labe præservásti, ut dignum Fílii tui habitáculum éffici mererétur. Qui tecum vivit.
S1207v.pc: Concéde miséricors Deus fragilitáti nostræ præsídium: ut qui immaculátæ Conceptiónis Genitrícis unigéniti Fílii tui festivitátem prævenímus; intercessiónis ejus auxílio a nostris iniquitátibus resurgámus: Per eúmdem Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who in her Conception wonderfully preserved the Mother of Your only-begotten Son from original sin, grant, we beseech You, that, defended by her intercession, You may make us clean of heart to take part in her feast
en.se: May the prayer of the immaculate Mother of God commend our offerings to Your clemency, O Lord, for You preserved her from every stain of original sin, that she might be made a worthy dwelling for Your Son
en.pc: Grant, merciful God, help to our frailty, that we who anticipate the feast of the immaculate Conception of the Mother of Your only-begotten Son may, by the help of her intercession, rise again from our iniquities

S0809v.or: Adésto Dómine supplicatiónibus nostris: et intercessióne beáti Lauréntii Mártyris tui, cujus prævenímus festivitátem; perpétuam nobis misericórdiam benígnus impénde: Per Dóminum.
S0809v.se: Hóstias, Dómine, quas tibi offérimus, propítius súscipe: et intercedénte beáto Lauréntio Mártyre tuo, víncula peccatórum nostrórum absólve. Per Dóminum.
S0809v.pc: Da, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut sicut beáti Lauréntii Mártyris tui commemoratióne, temporáli gratulámur offício; ita perpétuo lætémur aspéctu: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Be attentive, O Lord, to our supplications, and by the intercession of blessed Laurence Your Martyr, whose feast we anticipate, graciously bestow on us Your everlasting mercy
en.se: Mercifully receive, O Lord, the offerings we make to You, and by the intercession of blessed Laurence Your Martyr loose the bonds of our sins
en.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that as we rejoice in this service of time in commemoration of blessed Laurence Your Martyr, so we may rejoice for ever in beholding him

S0920v.or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Matthǽi Apóstoli tui et Evangelístæ, quam prævenímus, veneránda solémnitas; et devotiónem nobis áugeat, et salútem: Per Dóminum.
S0920v.se: Apostólici reveréntia cúlminis offeréntes tibi sacra mystéria, Dómine quǽsumus, ut beáti Matthǽi Apóstoli tui et Evangelístæ suffrágiis, cujus natalítia prævenímus, plebs tua semper et sua vota deprómat, et desideráta percípiat. Per Dóminum.
S0920v.pc: Sancti Apóstoli tui et Evangelístæ Matthǽi, quǽsumus Dómine, supplicatióne placátus: et véniam nobis tríbue; et remédia sempitérna concéde: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable solemnity of blessed Matthew, Your Apostle and Evangelist, which we anticipate, may increase in us both devotion and salvation
en.se: Offering You the sacred mysteries in reverence of his apostolic dignity, O Lord, we beseech You that, through the prayers of blessed Matthew Your Apostle and Evangelist, whose feast we anticipate, Your people may ever both pour forth their prayers and receive what they desire
en.pc: Appeased, O Lord, we beseech You, by the supplication of Your holy Apostle and Evangelist Matthew, grant us pardon and bestow on us everlasting remedies

S1027v.or: Concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut sicut Apostolórum tuórum Simónis et Iudæ gloriósa natalítia prævenímus; sic ad tua benefícia promerénda, majestátem tuam pro nobis ipsi prævéniant: Per Dóminum.
S1027v.se: Munéribus nostris, Dómine, sanctórum Apostolórum tuórum Simónis et Iudæ festa præcédimus, te supplíciter deprecántes, ut quæ consciéntiæ nostræ præpediúntur obstáculis, illórum méritis grata reddántur. Per Dóminum.
S1027v.pc: Sumpto, Dómine, sacraménto, supplíciter deprecámur: ut intercedéntibus beátis Apóstolis tuis Simóne et Juda; quod temporáliter gérimus, ad vitam capiámus ætérnam: Per Dóminum.

en.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that as we anticipate the glorious feast of Your Apostles Simon and Jude, so they may go before Your majesty on our behalf, that we may deserve Your benefits
en.se: With our gifts, O Lord, we go before the feast of Your holy Apostles Simon and Jude, humbly beseeching You that what is hindered by the obstacles of our conscience may be made pleasing by their merits
en.pc: Having received the sacrament, O Lord, we humbly beseech You that, by the intercession of Your blessed Apostles Simon and Jude, what we do in time we may receive unto life eternal

S1031v.or: Dómine Deus noster, multíplica super nos grátiam tuam: et quorum prævenímus gloriósa solémnia; tríbue súbsequi in sancta professióne lætítiam. Per Dóminum.
S1031v.se: Altáre tuum, Dómine, munéribus cumulámus oblátis: da quǽsumus, ut ad salútem nostram ómnium Sanctórum tuórum deprecatióne profíciant, quorum solémnia ventúra præcúrrimus. Per Dóminum.
S1031v.pc: Sacraméntis, Dómine, et gáudiis optátæ celebritátis explétis: quǽsumus, ut eórum précibus adjuvémur; quorum recordatiónibus exhibéntur: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O Lord our God, multiply Your grace upon us, and grant that we, who anticipate the glorious solemnity of Your Saints, may follow it with joy in holy profession
en.se: We heap Your altar, O Lord, with the gifts we have offered; grant, we beseech You, that by the prayers of all Your Saints, whose coming solemnity we go before, they may profit us unto salvation
en.pc: Having fulfilled the sacraments and joys of the longed-for feast, O Lord, we beseech You that we may be helped by the prayers of those whose memory they celebrate
